method: Actual browser UI through CUA, separate teacher and student tabs
checks: Teacher creates a new v5 classroom and sees QR plus student link.
Student joins that link; teacher sees one participant.
Teacher advances intro, round-one narrative and clues; student stays synchronized.
Round-one approved image, restored fictional names, and enlarged choices display correctly.
Student submits choice B; teacher receives one B vote.
Teacher closes voting; student receives class choice B, +2 popularity/trust, and Daon's named feedback.
limits: One live browser round. All eight live REST rounds are described separately in verification-live-service.json. Responsive sizes were checked in a desktop browser, not physical tablets.
